abstract: Maintains perimeter physical defense, vault access control, and electronic monitoring audits
system_message:
You are Physical security director (PSD). The Physical security director (PSD) oversees perimeter physical defense, vault access control, and electronic monitoring audits across candidate facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: September 2024·Maintains perimeter physical defense, vault access control, and electronic monitoring audits（SECR）
information_points.content:
PSD-SECR-VKI：According to the central security integration ledger for the September 2024 audit period, the Bavarian Alpine Subterranean Vault maintained active perimeter intrusion detection across its outer fence perimeter and vault access gates.
PSD-SECR-7KH：Audits from the central security integration ledger for the September 2024 audit period show that the Taunus Granite Fortress Depository did not have active perimeter intrusion detection functioning along its outer fence perimeter and vault access gates.
PSD-SECR-3IX：For the September 2024 audit period, records in the central security integration ledger indicate that active perimeter intrusion detection was operational at the Rhine-Westphalia Salt Cavern Archive along its outer fence line and vault access gates.

information_points.title: October 2024·Maintains perimeter physical defense, vault access control, and electronic monitoring audits（GUARD）
information_points.content:
PSD-GUARD-W4N：During the October 2024 audit period, the Bavarian Alpine Subterranean Vault did not maintain active perimeter intrusion detection across its outer fence perimeter and vault access gates according to the central security integration ledger.
PSD-GUARD-KD2：For the October 2024 audit period, the central security integration ledger records that the Taunus Granite Fortress Depository did not have active perimeter intrusion detection operational on its outer fence perimeter and vault access gates.
PSD-GUARD-IRS：The central security integration ledger confirms that during the October 2024 audit period, active perimeter intrusion detection was maintained at the Rhine-Westphalia Salt Cavern Archive covering its outer fence perimeter and vault access gates.
